Biophoton Therapy

Therapy frequency-medicine biophoton light-therapy cellular-communication coherence

Evidence: scientific

Summary

Biophoton therapy uses light stimulation to support cellular communication and coherence. Based on the theory that cells emit and receive coherent light (biophotons) for biological coordination. Enhances the body's self-regulation and healing capacity.

Type: frequency

Benefits

  • Cellular communication enhancement
  • Immune system support
  • Stress reduction
  • Sleep improvement
  • Cellular regeneration support

Contraindications

  • Photosensitive conditions
  • Active eye disease
  • Light epilepsy

Session Duration: 15-30 minutes per session

Frequency Recommendation: Daily or every other day, 5-10 sessions per cycle

Cost Range: $200-800 for home device
